description: This file defines the FooTable.Export component for exporting table data in JSON and CSV formats, and extends column serialization methods for different data types within the FooTable plugin.

classes.name: F.Export
classes.description: A component providing export functionality for FooTable, including methods to retrieve columns, rows, JSON, and CSV representations.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the export component, capturing a snapshot of table rows before paging.

methods.name: predraw
methods.description: Captures the current set of table rows before they are trimmed by paging.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns an array of column definitions excluding internal columns.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Returns an array of row data, optionally filtered to exclude filtered rows.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Returns table data as a JSON object with columns and rows.

methods.name: csv
methods.description: Returns table data as a CSV formatted string.
